brand.franchiseStatement: Authorized Franchisee Partner for Dr. Scent in Sri Lanka
brand.showroomAddress: VIA Scent Boutique, Level 3, One Galle Face / Crescat Boulevard, Colombo 03, Sri Lanka
brand.operatingHours: Monday – Saturday: 10:00 AM – 7:30 PM | Sunday: 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM

delivery.policyText: Standard islandwide delivery throughout Sri Lanka is charged at a flat rate of LKR 500 per order. All deliveries are tracked and dispatched via verified express couriers.
delivery.estimateText: Colombo & suburbs: 1-2 business days. Outstation & regional provinces: 2-4 business days.

returns.policyText: Customers may initiate a return within 7 calendar days of delivery. Returned items must be unused, in original packaging with seals intact. For damaged or defective arrivals, replacements are dispatched free of charge within 48 hours.

warranty.termsText: All Dr. Scent aroma diffusers sold by VIA Scent come with a 6-month official franchisee warranty covering internal pump performance and electrical defects under normal residential or commercial usage.
coveredItems: Touch screen and PCB electronic controller malfunction
Factory wiring and USB-C power connection issues
excludedItems: Physical impact or drop damage to glass/ceramic housing
Contamination or clogging from non-Dr. Scent diluted oils or water usage in waterless nebulizers
Unauthorized disassembly by non-VIA Scent technicians
